content: Give W0112 a daemon-compatible object-table resolver boundary that validates the region argument block, resolves generation- and permission-bound memory views, invokes the backend memory importer only after range checks, and proves Add/Copy reference closure without changing the stable ABI or Linux UAPI.

Content revision f7f45a70250f6d43b0d23116f2822a9a72003a08 adds CdevObjectTableResolver and its CPU-backed two-subrange regression. Focused cdev worker test passed 1/1, full development CTest passed 84/84, and git diff --check passed.
